name: holographic-vertical
title: Holographic (vertical)
description: Vertical: an iridescent foil orb with a shifting rainbow sheen, centred on the dark ground, the object centred on the field. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT); keeps its own material colour; every colour is a variable. Placement full, top or bottom card; fades in and out on cues.
